rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a divine messenger and, figuratively, for someone exceptionally kind or sweet.

example.english: In legends, an angel carries a god’s message down to the human world.
example.traditional: 傳說入面，天使會帶住神嘅旨意落凡間。
example.jyutping: cyun4 syut3 jap6 min6 tin1 si3 wui5 daai3 zyu6 san4 ge3 zi2 ji3 lok6 faan4 gaan1

rows.note: Use this for a plain description of someone as a good or kind person rather than the affectionate or idealized praise of 天使.

example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 go3 hou2 jan4

rows.note: Use this when angel means a beautiful girl, woman, or young person, especially in casual Hong Kong speech.

example.english: That beautiful girl has such a sweet smile; she’s an angel.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 leng3 neoi5 siu3 dak1 hou2 tim4
